C0097.title: Legal Analysis of Affiliate Commission Callback Hijacking in Thailand
C0097.summary: In May 2026, Law Gratis published a technical and legal analysis of affiliate commission callback hijacking in Thailand. It explained that third parties can divert attribution by overwriting tracking cookies, intercepting redirect chains, injecting affiliate IDs into callback URLs, manipulating pixels or API callbacks, or using malware and browser extensions to replace affiliate IDs. These tactics can cause advertisers to mispay commissions and legitimate affiliates to lose revenue. The article states that such conduct may be addressed under contract, tort, unjust-enrichment, computer-crime, or criminal-fraud rules in Thailand.

references.title: Affiliate Commission Callback Hijack Claims in THAILAND
